text: Entry 1375 replaces the old checked attribute with disabled on the native rememberPassword checkbox. Entry 1382 removes disabled, leaving its checked state to the password widget rather than retaining a fixed markup default. The accepted template is enabled. Keep this two-landing intermediate state historical; it does not establish a current policy against remembered passwords. Source alone does not explain why that temporary state was chosen, and no credential-storage test was run. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.
title: The remember-password control was temporarily disabled between two Hub landings
